mentions.name: AI SaaS web
mentions.description: An AI SaaS web app that makes it simple for users and small agencies to try LLMs from the lab. It addresses the problem that businesses with happy clients often end up with almost no client evaluations on their site, because asking clients directly is awkward and they say 'sure!' but rarely follow through with feedback.
mentions.problem: Sites with happy clients have almost no evaluations on their site; asking clients is awkward, they agree but never give feedback.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building ai saas web — the simplest way for user and small agencies to try LLM from lab.
